title: Serper (web search)
description: Google results through Serper as gohort's web search and image search, declared as a service: the requests and how their results are read are data you can test and fix from Admin > Connectors.
setup_notes: Get an API key at serper.dev (new accounts come with free searches). Since 30 October 2026 Google lets only the first few results of a search be opened: Serper gives the links after its top 3 as google.com/goto links, which gohort shows as having no usable link (title and snippet kept). Choose it under Admin > Capabilities > Web Search as Service and save; Test there makes one real search for a common phrase: <name>; agents' find_image searches pictures through it too. No price is declared, as it depends on your plan: add a per_call cost to the connector's spec to see what searches cost. Its key is given where it is used, under the choice, or under Settings on its row in Admin > Extensions > Connectors.
